name: gc-causes-check
title: Green Control · Causes & suggested check
description: When the AI is not sure: possible causes and one check that tells them apart.

files.content:
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { CONFIDENCE_REVIEW } from "@/components/ui/confidence-meter" /** * When the AI is not sure: the possible causes and one check that tells them apart. * Below 50% every cause reads "possible" and no fix is offered. * In the draft band (50–79) the leading cause reads "likely"; the others "maybe". */ export interface CausesCheckProps { confidence: number /** Ordered most to least likely. */ causes: string[] check: string onAssign?: () => void onKeepWatching?: () => void className?: string } export function CausesCheck({ confidence, causes, check, onAssign, onKeepWatching, className }: CausesCheckProps) { const low = confidence < CONFIDENCE_REVIEW const label = (i: number) => (low ? "possible" : i === 0 ? "likely" : "maybe") return (
What it could be · {confidence}%
    {causes.map((c, i) => (
  • {c} {label(i)}
    • ))}
Suggested check {check} {low && Not sure enough to suggest a fix yet.}
) }
